method.name: Closed
method.description: Checks if the oriented faces of the shell give a closed shell. If the wire is closed, returns BRepCheck_NoError. If <Update> is set to true, registers the status in the list.

method.name: Orientation
method.description: Checks if the oriented faces of the shell are correctly oriented. An internal call is made to the method Closed. If <Update> is set to true, registers the status in the list.
